'''Gas Tank''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A facility for storing gases.|When supplies run low, this gas tank can be modified to create improvised ammunition.}}
==Usage==
A facility for storing up to 500 unit of a type of gas.

Construction: Requires Specified Wuling AIC Plan Tech
